sloka: पूर्वं समभवत्तत्र ह्यगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः ।नाहं सुतस्तवेत्युक्त्वा मित्रं तस्मादपाक्रमत् ।। ७.५७.५ ॥
transliteration: pūrvaṁ samabhavattatra hyagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।nāhaṁ sutastavetyuktvā mitraṁ tasmādapākramat ।। 7.57.5 ॥

translations.english: First, the divine sage Agastya was born there, and having said "I am not your son," Mitra then departed from him.
